members.title: Tree members
members.adminOnlyNote: Only an administrator can invite or manage members.
members.noEmailSending: Automatically sending the invitation e-mail requires a Supabase Edge Function on your own project — in the meantime, copy the link and share it yourself.

preferences.title: Display preferences
preferences.defaultRootHelp: The person the family tree opens on when you sign in.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.newPhoto: New portrait on a followed branch
notifications.followedBranchesHelp: A followed branch covers the person and all their descendants.
notifications.noFollowed: No followed branch yet — use the "Follow this branch" button on an individual's page.
notifications.emailNote: Actually sending notification e-mails requires a scheduled Supabase Edge Function on your own project.

privacy.title: Privacy & GDPR
privacy.thresholdHelp: Anyone born fewer than this many years ago, with no recorded death, is hidden by default from viewers and in exports.

maintenance.title: Backup & maintenance
maintenance.snapshotHelp: Exports all the tree's data (records, unions, sources, media…) into a file you can restore later.
maintenance.restoreWarning: This replaces all of the tree's current genealogical content with the chosen file. Irreversible.
maintenance.cleanupHelp: Files present in storage but no longer linked to any media record.
maintenance.auditLogHelp: Who changed what, and when — across every record, administrators included.
maintenance.deleteTreeHelp: Permanently deletes all of this tree's content (records, unions, filiations, sources, media, activity log…) so you can start over with a clean import. Irreversible, and restricted to the tree's owner.
